# Playground — the example game / integration test. See the header comment in
# playground.hpp for what it covers.
add_executable(playground
    main.cpp
    playground.cpp
    scene_layout.cpp
    character.cpp
    day_weather.cpp
)
target_link_libraries(playground PRIVATE bracken)
bracken_copy_shaders(playground)

# Medieval village assets, generated by tools/build_medieval_assets.py from
# the (untracked) raw asset pack. Optional: without them the playground
# compiles the procedural-only fallback scene (village_layout.h is guarded by
# __has_include). Re-run CMake after generating the assets for the first time.
set(PLAYGROUND_GENERATED ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/generated)
if(EXISTS ${PLAYGROUND_GENERATED}/models/village.glb)
    target_include_directories(playground PRIVATE ${PLAYGROUND_GENERATED})
    add_custom_command(TARGET playground POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
            ${PLAYGROUND_GENERATED}/textures $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:playground>/assets/textures
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
            ${PLAYGROUND_GENERATED}/models $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:playground>/assets/models
        COMMENT "Staging playground village assets")
else()
    message(STATUS "playground: assets/generated/village.glb not found — building the "
                   "procedural-only fallback scene (see tools/build_medieval_assets.py)")
endif()

# Optional ctest registration: needs a GPU + display, so OFF by default.
# Enable with -DBRACKEN_PLAYGROUND_SMOKE_TEST=ON where a GPU is available.
# The option itself is declared in the top-level CMakeLists.txt so that
# enable_testing() is called even when BRACKEN_BUILD_TESTS is OFF.
if(BRACKEN_PLAYGROUND_SMOKE_TEST)
    add_test(NAME playground_smoke
             COMMAND playground --smoke 240
             WORKING_DIRECTORY $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:playground>)
    set_tests_properties(playground_smoke PROPERTIES LABELS "integration" TIMEOUT 180)
endif()
